ci: rebuild example images for Vega specs that differ from main (#9966)

Example images were only re-rendered when the build itself changed a
`.vg.json`. If a branch committed an updated `.vg.json` without its
images, they silently went stale (e.g. #9920, #9964).

Now images are also re-rendered for examples whose `.vg.json` differs
from `origin/main`, and the Check workflow fetches `main` so that
comparison works in CI.
